en: Psalms 49

p.src: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah.

en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah.
u.src: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah.

p.src: 1  Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,

en: Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,
u.src: 1  Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,

p.src: 2  both low and high, rich and poor together.

en: both low and high, rich and poor together.
u.src: 2  both low and high, rich and poor together.

p.src: 3  My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart will utter understanding.

en: My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart will utter understanding.
u.src: 3  My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart will utter understanding.

p.src: 4  I will incline my ear to a proverb. I will solve my riddle on the harp.

en: I will incline my ear to a proverb. I will solve my riddle on the harp.
u.src: 4  I will incline my ear to a proverb. I will solve my riddle on the harp.

p.src: 5  Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?

en: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?
u.src: 5  Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?

p.src: 6  Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—

en: Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—
u.src: 6  Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—

p.src: 7  none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.

en: none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.
u.src: 7  none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.

p.src: 8  For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,

en: For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,
u.src: 8  For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,

p.src: 9  that he should live on forever, that he should not see corruption.

en: that he should live on forever, that he should not see corruption.
u.src: 9  that he should live on forever, that he should not see corruption.

p.src: 10  For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.

en: For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.
u.src: 10  For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.

p.src: 11  Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever, and their dwelling places to all generations. They name their lands after themselves.

en: Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever, and their dwelling places to all generations. They name their lands after themselves.
u.src: 11  Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever, and their dwelling places to all generations. They name their lands after themselves.

p.src: 12  But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure. He is like the animals that perish.

en: But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure. He is like the animals that perish.
u.src: 12  But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure. He is like the animals that perish.

p.src: 13  This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings. Selah.

en: This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings. Selah.
u.src: 13  This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings. Selah.

p.src: 14  They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning. Their beauty shall decay in Sheol, far from their mansion.

en: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning. Their beauty shall decay in Sheol, far from their mansion.
u.src: 14  They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning. Their beauty shall decay in Sheol, far from their mansion.

en:
49:14 Sheol is the place of the dead.
49:14 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 15  But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah.

en: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah.
u.src: 15  But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah.

en: 49:15 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 16  Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

en: Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;
u.src: 16  Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

p.src: 17  for when he dies he will carry nothing away. His glory won’t descend after him.

en: for when he dies he will carry nothing away. His glory won’t descend after him.
u.src: 17  for when he dies he will carry nothing away. His glory won’t descend after him.

p.src: 18  Though while he lived he blessed his soul— and men praise you when you do well for yourself—

en: Though while he lived he blessed his soul— and men praise you when you do well for yourself—
u.src: 18  Though while he lived he blessed his soul— and men praise you when you do well for yourself—

p.src: 19  he shall go to the generation of his fathers. They shall never see the light.

en: he shall go to the generation of his fathers. They shall never see the light.
u.src: 19  he shall go to the generation of his fathers. They shall never see the light.

p.src: 20  A man who has riches without understanding, is like the animals that perish.

en: A man who has riches without understanding, is like the animals that perish.
u.src: 20  A man who has riches without understanding, is like the animals that perish.
